title: Nanomolar detection of lurasidone hydrochloride in pharmaceutical formulations (Serodopamoun®) and spiked urine using a PVC/imprinted polymer/MWCNTs layer deposited onto polyaniline-coated screen-printed electrodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39769-39778
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07098D, Paper
Open Access

Menna M. El-Beshlawy, Ahmed Barhoum, Fatehy M. Abdel-Haleem
This study developed potentiometric sensors for detecting lurasidone HCl (LSH), a vital drug for treating schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder, in pharmaceutical formulations and biological samples.
